marks.gloss_en: ולמה לי מחצה? אפילו בציר ממחצה נמי! והני משהו הוה ליה פלגא, ופלגא לא בטיל -- why half? even less than half: the bit [that fell] makes it half, and half is not nullified
R' Eliezer b. Yaakov: pure brine into which any amount of water fell is impure
אימא: עד מחצה -- read [the dictum as] 'up to half'
איבעית אימא: the impurities of an am haaretz and of liquids are rabbinic; they decreed for a majority, not for half-and-half (p_berubba_gazru)
the impurity of an am haaretz is rabbinic and the impurity of liquids is rabbinic; the Sages decreed for a majority, and for half-and-half they did not decree
R' Yochanan: both this and that -- [severe impurity too] until [it is unfit for] a dog
bar Padda's reason: 'you shall not eat any carcass; to the ger [within your gates you may give it]' (Devarim 14:21)
[R' Yochanan reads the verse] to exclude a carcass that was decayed from the outset
R' Yochanan: it is because of nullification in the majority that they touched upon it [and declared it not impure]
אילימא ארישא -- מיפלג פליגי רבי ישמעאל ורבי עקיבא: a disputed mishna is excluded by the dictum's own 'except for a dispute'
Rav: the halakha [follows the mishna] throughout the whole chapter, except for a dispute
משנת רבי אליעזר בן יעקב קב ונקי -- that the halakha follows him is already known
(proposed) the dictum refers to R' Eliezer ben Yaakov's ruling
אלא אדרבן שמעון בן גמליאל -- מפלג פליג בברייתא: a tanna disputes RSBG in a baraita (identified at 24a.4: מאי ברייתא? דתניא ... הבא אחריו בכור מספק)
אלא אדרבי יוסי בן המשולם -- הא אמר רב חדא זימנא, דאמר רב: הלכתא כרבי יוסי בן המשולם
אלא אשער בעל מום -- מיפלג פליגי עקביא בן מהללאל ורבנן
(proposed) the dictum refers to R' Yosei ben HaMeshullam's ruling
לעולם אדרבן שמעון בן גמליאל, והא קא משמע לן: דברייתא לא פלוגתא היא (= p_baraita_lav_plugta)
the dictum refers to Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel's ruling [in the mishna]
RSBG (mishna): one who buys a nursing animal from a gentile need not be concerned that it was another's young [it nursed]
